claims: Colby Covington defeated Dillon Danis via a 14-4 technical fall in a wrestling match at Real American Freestyle (RAF) 7 on March 28, 2026, in Tampa, Florida.
There was a 4-4 tie in the first period.
Colby Covington dominated the second period, according to Yahoo Sports and Bloody Elbow.
The match type was freestyle wrestling (not MMA or boxing), according to Instagram.
Colby Covington won by technical fall (14-4) in Period 2.
Colby Covington dominated the second period with takedowns and mat control, as reported in the MMA Fighting live blog.
Colby Covington called out Chris Weidman for his next match in the promotion following his win, according to Yahoo Sports.
Colby Covington and Dillon Danis nearly came to blows during a pre-fight press conference, according to Yahoo Sports.
Colby Covington and Dillon Danis exchanged personal insults during a pre-fight press conference, according to Yahoo Sports.
The match served as the co-main event of the RAF 7 card.
